description.ncbi_summary: Lysophospholipases are enzymes that act on biological membranes to regulate the multifunctional lysophospholipids. The protein encoded by this gene has lysophospholipase activity. It is composed of two identical subunits which are held together by disulfide bonds. This protein has structural similarity to several members of the beta-galactoside-binding S-type lectin family. [provided by RefSeq, Jul 2008].

uniprot_function.text: Binds beta-galactoside and lactose. Strong inducer of T-cell apoptosis (PubMed:10527825, PubMed:19497882). Has hemagglutinating activity towards chicken erythrocytes (PubMed:29343868). Acts as an activator of ferroptosis: secreted by ferroptotic cells and acts by reducing localization of SLC7A11 at the plasma membrane (PubMed:40246981).
